summary.text: Tony Kiepe is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 3-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Natasha Hill.
Kiepe also ran for this seat in 2024 and advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 31.2% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Kiepe ran for District 3-Position 1 in 2024, when the seat had no incumbent, and placed first in the August 6, 2024 primary with 35.5% of the vote.
Hill defeated him in the November 5, 2024 general election, 58.6% to 41.1%.
